text:
Aria: Hi payroll  my Sep 20 paycheck withheld ~e2,400 for Irish PAYE on a relocation bonus. I was seconded to IE starting 2025-09-15 and uploaded the treaty form on 2025-09-10. I think it should have been treated under US payroll with treaty relief. Can someone check?

Sana (Payroll): Sorry to hear that. Can you paste the payrun id or paystub link and confirm the GM secondment effective date?

Aria: paystub link: https://files.redwood.internal/paystubs/aria-0920.png. payrun: payrun-20250920-07. GM shows secondment start 2025-09-15 and doc aria_secondment_20250910.pdf uploaded.

Diego (Global Mobility): I confirm we received the packet and the tax doc on 2025-09-10 11:03. Checking integration: looks like the filename didn't match the expected pattern, so the payroll flag wasn't set. Snippet: 
```
2025-09-10T11:03:12Z gm-upload: aria_secondment_20250910.pdf uploaded
2025-09-10T11:03:14Z iam-sync: expected aria_secondment_20250910_signed.pdf -> filename_mismatch
2025-09-10T11:03:15Z payroll-webhook: treaty_flag=false
```

Sana (Payroll): That explains it. We'll open ticket, reprocess payrun, and issue an off-cycle refund for the net withheld amount while we fix filings.

TaxBot: Ticket PR-2025-404 opened. Priority: high. Actions: confirm doc, re-run mapping, off-cycle net refund, prepare reclaim letters if needed.

Tom (Manager): Timeline? Employee flagged this as urgent for upcoming mortgage payment.

Sana (Payroll): Off-cycle net refund scheduled 2025-09-25 EOD. Reprocess queued; if PAYE was already filed we may need to request a reclaim. Payroll will assist with documentation.

Diego (Global Mobility): I fixed the filename in the document store to aria_secondment_20250910_signed.pdf and retriggered metadata sync.

Sana (Payroll): Reprocess ran: treaty_flag=true now. Reprocess results: bonus gross e6,000; original Irish PAYE e2,120; corrected withholding 0 under treaty. Off-cycle net refund amount matches (minor currency rounding).

TaxBot: PR-2025-404 update: reprocess completed 2025-09-21T15:42Z. Off-cycle refund chk-OC-7582 cleared 2025-09-25. Corrected paystub uploaded: https://files.redwood.internal/paystubs/aria-0925-corrected.pdf

Aria: Off-cycle deposit received and I downloaded corrected statement. Thank you.

Tom (Manager): Two follow-ups: can GM get a short runbook for exact filename conventions? Also payroll, can we add a pre-payrun validation to flag treaty docs uploaded within 14 days of a payrun?

Sana (Payroll): Agreed. I'll draft a one-pager and add a pre-payrun validation alert to the pipeline. Will share next week.

TaxBot: PR-2025-404 closed 2025-09-25. Close notes: off-cycle refund issued, payrun reprocessed, corrected statement uploaded, GM filename guidance updated, runbook task DOC-2025-17 created.
